summary: Robert Evans and Sofiya Alexandra begin reading Ben Shapiro's book Porn Generation, which blames social liberalism, feminism and sex education for corrupting American youth, and check its claims against data showing young people have less sex.
keywords: How Social Liberalism Is Corrupting Our Future

evidence.note: Opens with a Shapiro video clip mocking the Peg the Patriarchy outfit before the reading starts
Host first dates the book to 2008, then corrects himself to 2013
Hosts cite studies showing millennials have less casual sex, rebutting the book's panic
Book uses a Tom Wolfe fictional character as a case study of college women
Chapter two on school sex education built around an interviewee named Katie
Host previews remaining chapter titles and says the reading will continue

notes: Hosts date Porn Generation to 2013 (after first saying 2008); it was actually published in 2005. Time follows the transcript as in the sibling story; reviewer may prefer 2005. Covered end 2019 comes from the opening Shapiro pegging clip (about 3 minutes). Studies from 2014-2018 are host rebuttals, not story years.
